Add selectAtomsBtn (title bar, first) with pointer cursor, gated by Allow-selections checkbox; draft mode force-exits selection. Click handling: atoms via order maps, bonds via svgBondList ranges, implicit-C/skeletal via JSME vertex mapping with deterministic fallback; condensed CHn groups atoms; compacted labels select whole fragment. v56: native-channel cyan selection + hover preview + pick accuracy

Selection look rework: paint through the native JSME background channel
instead of DOM halos (palette slot 2 -> #22d3ee, slots are 1-based;
boot-time merge wrapper, component-wins; resets for clears since JSME
ignores empty-string sets; Present pushes component-only; install
verified + self-healing retry; draft applet untouched).
Condensed hidden members paint-filtered via the compaction skip set
(anchor only paints); fill-restricted circle twin of the near-text
cleanup.
Pick accuracy: order maps exclude hidden atoms; bond groups adjust for
compaction-deleted lines (per-render removed-bond record); near-text
collector skips the bg (index 0); anchors prefer text centers;
skeletal sp-C labels hidden not deleted + marker-skipped; skeletal
heteroatoms resolve geometrically via bond-endpoint proximity.
Hover preview: rAF-throttled mousemove reuses the click pick path,
stroke-only cyan ring overlay (DOM-only, never the applet channel),
per-render geometry cache, armed-mode only (SW 30, bond 110, 0.55 op).
Probe-final asserts cyan fill + hover ring. Docs updated.
Owner tweaks kept as-is (selectAtomsBtn icon, crosshair cursor,
init-3.spt picking off). index.html stays on v55.

v56: quiz 1C — selection, order, direction, multi-chain + hover

2D atom/bond click-to-select (atoms toggle on plain click, JSmol-style;
shift identical; kinds exclusive; Esc/empty-canvas clears), hover preview
(rAF-throttled DOM ring, per-render geometry cache), native-channel cyan
paint with reset-first exactness, pick accuracy (order maps, compaction-aware
bond groups, bg protection, skeletal hetero anchors, joint adoption for
multi-line C-side ends).
Quiz: box click while armed sets a target (main chain first); live
set-compare with exact/subset/wrong/disjoint verdicts; pick-order badges;
walk must be bonded (order verdict); C1-first direction enforced
(direction verdict); pool-wide multi-chain acceptance with auto-adopt
(stepper path, adopted-only in data mode); either direction accepted for
symmetric chains (orienter-indifference oracle). Probe-quiz added.
Owner live-tested selection + hover; formal node --check + harness matrix
pending on the browser machine. index.html stays on v55.

v56: main-chain compacted-carbon picks, paint hardening, skeletal vertex joints

Main-chain purpose (compCarbonsCount target): a carbon-anchored compact
label resolves to its anchor carbon only, whole-label/backplate hit area
included; free selection keeps the whole fragment; N/S anchors never
convert. Arming normalizes an existing carbon fragment; paint restores the
backplate, hides the native ellipse and draws a glyph-sized path behind the
carbon glyph; badge and hover follow that glyph.

Review hardening: the enlarged hit area is main-chain-only (free selection
keeps the glyph run), the paint is idempotent via a backplate marker
(component green still wins, Present hidden), the C-only path and ellipse
hide survive a missing backplate, and the ellipse hide is ownership-guarded
by the label backing rect.

Skeletal joints: offset ends of multi-line bonds merge into their true joint
before vertex-to-atom assignment, so aldehyde carbonyl carbons pick the
carbon instead of the oxygen (propanal/butanal/pentanal/propynal) and
ethanal's joint/methyl end resolve correctly; ketones, acids, esters and
methanal keep their assignments.

Probes: probe-compact-main (free vs main, C-only paint, methanal, free
backplate edge, clear restore), probe-skel-joints (16 molecules, joint
invariants). Verified: full harness matrix green, node --check and
git diff --check clean. index.html stays on v55.

v56: final-only quiz verdicts, selection-mode viewer ownership, explain-all fix

Quiz verdicts: partial picks, outside-chain atoms and no-overlap stay silent;
only exact, and direction/order once the picked set is complete, are shown.

Selection mode owns the viewer: fExplainNameComp early-returns while select
mode is armed (one-shot __mulerQuizReward for the exact reward), so 2D-style
switches never paint the name-component highlight. A main-chain quiz target
survives a style switch (molecule change still disarms) and the prompt is
re-asserted; picked atoms are dropped with the old geometry.

Explain-all overview: the quiet build may generate explanation text again
(no more nested explainTable in every explainCell), the scrape rejects its
own markup, closing restores the quiz prompt/clears the panel, and arming or
an exact verdict repaints the cached table.

Selection fill detection derives hex + rgb forms from MULER_SELECT_CYAN
(#6ddcbe in the working tree) with legacy cyan kept; the compaction circle
cleanup shares the helper, and the sequence badge follows the palette.

Probes: probe-quiz final-only assertions, probe-mode-quiz, probe-explain-all,
probe-compact-main derives the selection color instead of hardcoding cyan.
Verified: full harness matrix green; node --check + git diff --check clean.

  double locant, single-bond wording), ether alkoxy name/locant

Static verification only (balanced braces, lang-key coverage, wiring

+# Chemistry review — `core-56.js` and `molview-56.js` (v56)
+
+Date: 2026-11-13. Scope: all chemistry in [js/mulermoc-nom-core-56.js](../js/mulermoc-nom-core-56.js) (structure analysis, group detection, main-chain choice, numbering, naming, 3D mirror) and the chemistry paths of [js/mulermoc-nom-molview-56.js](../js/mulermoc-nom-molview-56.js) (draft sandbox, condensed-formula renderer, systematic Greek substituent variants, quiz chain comparison). UI, highlighting and layout code in molview was not reviewed.
+
+Status: items 1–7 and the orientation items O1–O2 below are **fixed** in this change set. Everything under "Open / recommended" is documented but not changed.
+
+## Verification
+
+Regression page: [zz-test-core56.html](../zz-test-core56.html) (serve the repo root, e.g. `python -m http.server 8099`, open the page; title becomes `CORE56-DONE PASS|FAIL`, full JSON in `#out`).
+
+- All 141 stored molecules: Greek name, English name, slot list, functional groups and main chain compared before/after, plus the 3D mirror (`fParseSDF3D` → `fDetectMolType3D` → `fCalcMainChain3D`) for all 141 stored SDFs. **0 differences** against `HEAD`.
+- 31 drawn probes (SMILES → MOL → the draft path `fAnalyseStructure` / `fDetectMolType` / `fGuessName` + EN transliteration), each with an expected English name or an expected decline. **31/31 pass.**
+- Not run: `node --check` (no Node on the review machine; the page loads and executes both files in Chrome), the interactive Chrome harness in `tools/muler-harness/`.
+- Expanded ethane: browser clicks on three hydrogens attached to one carbon verified individual selection and paint, quiz rejection of H as carbon, and successful carbon-only quiz completion.
+
+## Fixed
+
+| # | Problem | Where | Before → after |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| 1 | Locants sorted as text (`[10,2]`) | `fGuessName`: double/triple-bond locants, nitro, alcohol/ketone, multi-FG | `10,2-dodecadiene` → `2,10-dodecadiene` (`dodeca-10,2-diene` → `dodeca-2,10-diene`) |
+| 2 | Halogens silently dropped when another group is present | `fGuessName` multi-FG branch (local `fgOrder` had no halogen) | `ClCCO` named `ethanol` → `2-chloroethanol`; halogens are now substituent prefixes with their own locants |
+| 3 | Locants of different substituent types shared one accumulator | multi-FG loop | one entry per substituent type, alphabetical by substituent name, each with its own locants (serine-like: `2-amino-3-hydroxypropanoic acid`) |
+| 4a | Principal alcohol/ketone locant never emitted with other groups | multi-FG branch | `1-hydroxypentanone` → `5-hydroxypentan-2-one` (same length thresholds as the single-group path) |
+| 4b | Wrong accent rule: `_principalEntry` used the first-inserted key, not the principal group | `fGuessName` | principal group (by `gFunctionalGroupsOrder`) now decides; removes `αιθάνόλη`-type double accents |
+| 4c | Crash when amine/nitro was the principal group (`.O` undefined) | multi-FG branch | declines (`unsupported principal group`) |
+| 4d | A C-C multiple bond in a multi-FG molecule lost its locant (`comp0` overwritten) | multi-FG branch | declines; none of the stored molecules combine the two |
+| 5 | Unsupported groups/elements fell through to a hydrocarbon name of the carbon skeleton | `fGuessName` entry | whitelist (`gNamableElements`, `gNamableSingleGroups`, `gNamablePrincipalGroups`, `gNamablePrefixGroups`); everything else calls `fDeclineNaming`. `CCCN=O` was `propanal`, `CCS` was `ethane`, `CNC` was `methane`, `CCC=N` was `propane`, amines were `propaneamine` (wrong for 2-propanamine and the English form) |
+| 6 | Polynitro lost its multiplier | nitro path | `1,3-nitropropane` → `1,3-dinitropropane` (empty prefix for one group, so mononitro is byte-identical) |
+| 7a | Terminal `=O` on N classified as ketone/aldehyde | `fDetectMolType`, `fDetectMolType3D` | O on a nitro N is skipped (belongs to the nitro group); O on any other N → `unsupported` → decline. Pentavalent `O=N(=O)R` now named as nitro |
+| 7b | Nitro detection accepted any N with ≥2 O (nitrate ester, N-oxide) | N branch of both detectors; `fIsNitroNitrogen` | nitro = exactly one C and two O on N |
+| 7c | Nitro N anchor taken from `connList[N][0]`, which is an O when the O bond comes first (drawn from the O side → bogus `nitro off main chain` decline or wrong anchor) | new `fAnchorCarbonOf`, used in Step 5 (2D and 3D) and the nitro/multi-FG naming sites | `O=[N+]([O-])CCC[N+](=O)[O-]` and `[N+](=O)([O-])CCO` now name correctly |
+| O1 | All alcohol/ketone/amine carbons counted as "principal" in the lowest-locant tiers | `fCalcMainChain` / `fCalcMainChain3D` Step 5 | only the senior of the three is principal; a junior one (OH beside C=O) is a prefix. `4-hydroxypentan-2-one`, not `2-hydroxypentan-4-one` |
+| O2 | Ester (priority 4) outranked carboxylic acid (3) when choosing C1 | Step 5, 2D and 3D | acid 4, ester 3 (matches the header comment and `gFunctionalGroupsOrder`) |
+
+Behavioural note: some structures that previously produced a **wrong** name now **decline** (amines, imines, nitroso, S/P compounds, hydroxy-ethers, esters mixed with other groups, multi-FG + C=C). For drafts this shows the existing "Engine failed — check the drawing" toast; stored molecules are unaffected. This follows the engine's fail-closed contract (v54.23: "a wrong locant is worse than no name").
+
+Expanded-mode hydrogen selections remain hydrogen selections in the quiz as well as in the viewer; they do not count as their attached carbon. The earlier proposed H-fold was reverted.
+
+## Open / recommended (not changed)
+
+1. **Alphabetical order in core uses raw string compare** (`fGuessName` branch/halogen/nitro merge, `fCarbonBranchAlphabeticalKey`). `sec-`/`tert-` (Latin) sort before every Greek name, and the merged halogen/nitro groups sort with the `δι`/`τρι` multiplier included. molview's `fGRSubstSortKey` is correct; core should share it so the view and engine cannot disagree.
+2. **Chain selection is unsaturation-first, then length** (pre-2013 convention). Probably intentional for the Greek curriculum, but it is not the 2013 rule (P-44.3: length first). Document it as a teaching decision. The all-or-nothing FG filter in `fRankChainPool` has no "maximum number of principal groups" fallback.
+3. **Substituent tier ignores multiplicity** (`getSubstituentLocantSet` iterates `Object.keys(anchorCarbons)`, so geminal `2,2` counts as `2`). Later tiers rescue the cases checked; fragile.
+4. **2D/3D drift.** The 3D Tier-4 alphabetical tie-break covers fewer graph types than 2D, and ~800 lines are duplicated. `fMatchNumberedMainChain3D` mostly hides this by mapping from the 2D chain. `fParseSDF3D` splits bond lines on whitespace, which breaks at ≥100 atoms (fixed-width columns merge).
+5. **Terminal-group count prefix is capped at `δι`** for ≥3 groups (single-FG cyanide/aldehyde/acid and multi-FG principal). Three terminal groups cannot all be on a chain end, so this is a branch case that should decline.
+6. **Cyclic input** is only guarded at the draft entry (`fMolDraftHasRing`); `fCalcMainChain` still falls back to listing all carbons if a ring reaches it another way.
+7. **Hetero anchors elsewhere** (e.g. molview highlight code) may still assume `atomConnectivityList[n][0]` is carbon for a nitro N; only the core sites were changed.
+8. **Amines are now out of scope** (decline). If wanted, add them next to alcohol/ketone with locants and an EN `-amine` suffix (the current EN transliteration produced `propaneamine`).
+
+## What was found correct
+
+- Lowest-locant tier order (suffix group → multiple bonds → double before triple → prefixes → alphabetical), `fCompareLocantSets` (first point of difference, not sums).
+- Ester and carboxylic-acid pairing in `fDetectMolType` for the supported scope; formate and lactone guards in `fIsAcyclicSaturatedMonoesterGraph`.
+- Condensed-formula renderer (`fMolDraftRenderNode` / `fMolDraftExpandedFormula`): standard valence, acid/aldehyde/nitrile/ester forms.
+- `ALKYL_SYS_NUMBERING` and `GR_SYST_SUBST` are consistent with each other.

+# Roadmap — next development (v55 working tree, 2026-11-12; v56 implements it)
+
+Two workstreams, ordered by dependency. Status: UI entry + phase 1B done
+(selection button, gating, 2D click capture + cyan overlay paint); 1C
+(compare/validate) and workstream 2 pending. Harness (`muler-harness`,
+Playwright + installed Chrome) is the verification vehicle for both.
+
+---
+
+## 1. Clickable 2D/3D molecules + validation against name components
+
+**Goal:** the user clicks an atom or a bond (2D and 3D); the selection
+highlights; Shift-click accumulates; the selection is stored in a variable
+and can be compared/validated against a name component (main chain,
+functional group, substituent, locants…).
+
+### What exists today (no new research needed here)
+
+- **2D overlay already knows atom identity.** The native-SVG overlay keeps
+  `atomTextMap[atomIdx]`, `atomRectMap[atomIdx]` and `textNodeAtomIndexMap`
+  (`molview-55.js:5253,5278,6074`), plus a `colorContext.atomIdx` channel
+  used by the painters (`:5944–5963, :6234, :6263`). Bond lookup by atom
+  pair exists: `fFindBondIndexByAtoms` (`:5299`). → 2D clicks bind on the
+  app-owned SVG overlay, **not** inside the JSME depict applet (vendor
+  code, do not touch).
+- **Highlight painters exist and are quiet-flaggable**: `fHighlightAtomChain[3D]`,
+  `fHighLightMainChain[Bonds]`, `fHighlightMultiBonds[3D]`,
+  `fHighlightSingleBondsCC[3D]`, `fShowAnalysisNumbering` (`:11660–13105`,
+  all `__mulerExplainQuiet`-aware). Reuse them; do not fork new paint code.
+- **Component atom sets exist** as engine globals: `mainChainAtomsList`
+  (+3D via `fTranslateChain2D3D`, `:10642`), FG fragments via
+  `nameMainCompObj*` (`:9096, :11835`), branch groups
+  (`fGetHydrocarbonBranchGroup`, `fDescribeCarbonBranches`). Validation =
+  set comparison against these, not new analysis.
+- **2D↔3D isomorphism map exists** (`fTranslateChain2D3D`, chain stepper,
+  Edit-accept path all use it) — reuse for cross-viewer selection sync.
+- Precedent for stored-highlight replay: scenario apply seeds stored mode
+  before `fSelectMol` (sticky-selection work). Same pattern for replaying a
+  user selection after viewer reloads.
+
+### Phases
+
+**1A — input spike (harness-verified, no UI yet).**
+- 2D: delegated click listener on `#jsmeNomeclatureSVG`; resolve target →
+  atom index via the existing node→index map (fallback: nearest
+  `atomRectMap` rect); bond clicks resolve via the two endpoint atoms +
+  `fFindBondIndexByAtoms`. Condensed-mode groups (`CH₃` = one shape):
+  decide group semantics (select = all member atoms; record both the group
+  and its atoms).
+- 3D: verify which pick path the bundled JSmol honors (pick callback vs
+  `show picked` read-back). If neither is reliable, fallback is click-ray
+  via `getPropertyAsArray` — spike decides, do not guess.
+- Deliverable: console-level proof — clicking logs `{viewer, kind, index}`.
+  If JSMol picking is unavailable, STOP and replan (do not build 2D-only
+  silently).
+
+**1B — selection model + paint.**
+- New global, e.g. `window.MulerUserSelection = { molKey, epoch, atoms2D: [],
+  bonds2D: [], atoms3D: [], bonds3D: [] }`. Epoch = current `molText`/molKey:
+  any molecule switch, Draw, or teardown invalidates (same epoch-guard
+  discipline as the minimize pipeline).
+- Plain click replaces, Shift-click accumulates, Esc / click-empty clears.
+  Paint through the existing highlight painters (selection style must be
+  visually distinct from component highlight — e.g. outline vs fill; owner
+  picks the skin).
+- Cross-viewer: selecting in 2D mirrors to 3D via the isomorphism map
+  (heavy atoms; H follows its parent or is ignored — decide in 1A).
+- Disabled in Present by default (authoring-only aid like eye-edit; the
+  `QUIZ-FUTURE` hook is the natural later consumer).
+
+**1C — compare/validate vs component (v56 working tree: quiz mode, main chain first).**
+- Quiz target: clicking a name box while select mode is armed sets
+  `window.MulerQuizTarget` instead of highlighting (unarmed clicks + stored
+  scenario replay via `__mulerQuizReplayBypass` keep classic behavior).
+  v1 resolver table has the main chain only (`compCarbonsCount` →
+  shared-resolution helper); FG/branch/bond-aware resolvers extend it later.
+- Compare: order-insensitive set compare, H folded to heavy parent,
+  bonds v1-ignored. Verdicts: exact / subset / wrong (outsiders reported by
+  count in the verdict line, no red paint) / disjoint; empty hint. Exact
+  sets additionally require a bonded walk end to end; the sequence must
+  match the C1-first chain (engine-oriented via lowest-locant tiers) —
+  a full reverse match gets a `direction` verdict, scrambled sets an
+  `order` verdict with the break reported by pick numbers. Badges
+  (`mulerSelNum*`) below each picked label. Multiple tied chains: acceptance
+  spans the whole ranked pool (each entry C1-oriented); an exact match on a
+  non-live entry auto-adopts it via the stepper path (adopted-only in data
+  mode, where curation wins). Symmetric chains (all lowest-locant tiers tie)
+  accept either direction as exact via an orienter-indifference oracle —
+  no pool duplication, no adoption needed for them.
+- Reward: exact match replays the classic component path (green +
+  numbering + explanation), no new paint code. Verdict line is a plain
+  `#mulerQuizVerdict` div (inline-styled, no CSS dependency); prompt replaces
+  the explanation while armed. Esc clears the pick but keeps the target;
+  re-click/exit/draft/molecule-change disarm. Present: merge ignores the
+  quiz, no quiz paint. TTS skipped on success (v1).
+
+### Risks / open calls (owner)
+
+- JSmol picking API uncertainty → spike first (1A gate).
+- Condensed-group semantics (group vs atoms) — propose: store both.
+- H handling in selections and in compare (H = part of parent vs own pick).
+- Present mode: authoring-only, or read-only quiz consumer later?
+
+### Acceptance
+
+- Click atom/bond in each 2D mode + 3D → highlight + selection var updates;
+  Shift accumulates; Esc clears; molecule switch invalidates.
+- Validate vs main chain on 3 molecules: exact, subset, disjoint → correct
+  verdicts; oracle/eye/narration flows untouched (`node --check` + harness
+  matrix incl. EN + collapsed rail).
+
+---
+
+## 2. Data-structure decision (one file vs per-molecule; redundant vs derived)
+
+### Current state (measured, not assumed)
+
+- **Stored 141 = minimal:** per key only `formula` + `mainChain_*` (+`mainChain3D`)
+  (`jsme-nick-nomeclature-moc2-data_55.js`); MOL text lives in the `MOL2D`
+  map in the same file; 3D SDF in `mols/<key>_3D.sdf`.
+- **Customs = rich snapshot:** `MULERMOC_*_data.js` files merge via
+  `window.nameExamplesCustom` → boot-folded into `nameExamples`
+  (`molview-55.js:462`), carrying slots, SMILES, classification, verdicts,
+  history, `sdf3DSource` (+ MOLs/SDF — verify exact embedding when
+  implementing).
+- So today both philosophies already coexist, split by provenance. The
+  question is which one wins going forward.
+
+### Options
+
+- **A. One file for all.** Single source, single diff to review; but the
+  file is already ~MB-scale, Accept-time rewrites risk conflicts, and
+  per-molecule history gets noisy.
+- **B. One file per molecule (status-quo direction).** Matches the custom
+  flow; boot merge already works (`Object.assign`, stored keys win);
+  pain point is manual `<script>` registration per file (noted in
+  `mulermoc-nom-55.html`) → needs a manifest/registry, not more tags.
+- **C. Normalized core + derived cache.** Store only non-derivable facts
+  (MOLs, SMILES, CID, verdicts, history, `sdf3D(+Source)`); recompute
+  slots/names at boot via the engine (single source of truth) with a
+  freshness/version stamp to detect engine drift. Kills redundancy
+  (slots duplicating engine output), costs boot time, loses frozen
+  eval-data unless predictions are snapshotted separately.
+
+### Recommendation (for owner decision)
+
+Keep **B for layout** (per-molecule files; add a manifest so registration
+is one line) with **C for content**: custom files store non-derivable
+facts only and recompute derivations at boot, stamped with the engine
+version. Stored 141 stay minimal; migrate them only if the manifest work
+forces it. Backfill/verify with a headless pass over all keys (slots and
+names byte-identical before/after, same discipline as the v54.23 no-op
+proofs).
+
+### Open questions (owner)
+
+1. Does any downstream flow (eval tables, REVIEW docs) rely on stored
+   *predictions* as frozen data, or can they be recomputed?
+2. Boot-cost tolerance offline (141 × engine pass) vs frozen-snapshot speed?
+3. Who hand-edits data files — do we need human-diffable MOL sections?
+4. Point-1 interplay: should user selections/validation verdicts persist
+   into molecule records (schema impact), or stay session-only?
+
+### Sequencing with workstream 1
+
+Independent except 1C persistence (Q4). Suggested order: 1A spike and the
+Q1–Q4 decisions in parallel → manifest + normalization → 1B/1C on the
+settled schema. Do not let 1B invent a second selection-persistence
+format before Q4 is answered.
+
+---
+
+## Verification standard (both workstreams)
+
+`node --check` on touched files; harness matrix (GR/EN × 1500/1100,
+drawer open, collapsed rail) with screenshots for visual changes;
+headless byte-identical proofs for any data migration; CHANGELOG +
+SESSION-NOTES entries per batch, following repo convention.

+# muler-harness (headless verification)
+
+Playwright + installed Chrome probes for the MuLERMoC v56 working tree.
+Run from the repo root. Requires node + Playwright (`npm i playwright-core`
+once, anywhere on NODE_PATH or in this dir) and a Chrome binary.
+
+Assumptions (edit the constant at the top of each probe if yours differ):
+- repo served at `http://localhost:8901` via `server.js` below
+  (override via `MULER_BASE`, e.g. `MULER_BASE=http://localhost:8902`);
+- Chrome at `C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe`
+  (override via `MULER_CHROME`; if the path does not exist the probe lets
+  Playwright resolve the browser on its own).
+- Cold-load waits use `waitForFunction` on the JSME SVG + selection API
+  (30 s timeout) + short settle, not fixed 14 s sleeps.
+
+Scripts are read-only against the app; screenshots land in the current
+working directory.
+
+- `server.js [port]` — minimal static file server for the repo root
+  (no-cache, correct MIME incl. `.sdf`). Start first, in the background:
+  `node tools/muler-harness/server.js 8901`
+- `probe-final.js` — end-to-end smoke: cold load, atom pick, hover preview,
+  empty-canvas clear, and mode-switch invalidation. Prints state JSON.
+- `probe-pick7.js <mol> <condensed|expanded|skeletal> "atom,N [s]" ...`
+  — generic pick tester: `atom,3` clicks the 3rd text anchor (0-based),
+  `bond,2` clicks the middle of bond index 2, trailing `s` = shift-click,
+  `empty` = click empty canvas. Prints resulting selection after each step.
+- `probe-shift.js` — shift-accumulate check on ethane (CTM-derived 2nd pick, asserts accumulation).
+- `probe-quiz.js` — main-chain quiz: checks bond hover/click suppression without losing atom picks in condensed, expanded and skeletal modes, plus normal bond behavior outside the quiz; checks live numberless hints, exact success, reverse direction and scrambled order; screenshot `quiz-green.png`.
+- `probe-fg-quiz.js` — FG suffix quiz (set-only, numberless, atoms-only): ethanol O pick exacts with no badges, carbon-first gives a numberless non-hetero/non-gap hint, hydrocarbon -ιο never arms, bond clicks are ignored while armed, condensed COOH label click takes the heavy fragment, and expanded ethanal accepts its explicit aldehyde H.
+- `probe-loc-quiz.js` — locant-box quiz (shared FG task, purpose "loc", chain-first prerequisite): EN pentanone_2/comp4 and GR pentanone_2/comp0 redirect to chain, then auto-arm loc with numbering aid and a cleared chain verdict; full picks exact; dione comp7 completes the same cycle.
+- `probe-bond-quiz.js` — bond quiz (number locants redirect to chain; type boxes arm directly): butene_1 comp6 double-bond atoms exact, bond-line pick exacts alone, bonds hover in quiz; butyne_2 comp4 locant redirects, solves, auto-arms triple and exacts on a bond click; methyl_3_pentyn_4_ol_2 comp4 triple locant in an FG-position box (unarmed names the triple bond, never hydroxyl; armed redirects, auto-arms bond); ethyl_3_methyl_4_octen_3_yn_5_dione_2_7 comp4 double locant alpha to a 2-keto (same bond-not-FG contract); butadiene_1_3 reversed 4-atom set; ethane "αν" all-singles exact with single-bond wording (never "multiple bond"); wrong picks give bond-flavored numberless hints.
+- `probe-branch-quiz.js` — branch quiz (locants redirect to chain; name boxes arm directly; name = short prompt, locant = long "indicated position" prompt; numbering aid on locants only): hydrocarbon and ester-alkyl behavior; systematic ether alkoxy boxes arm O + alkoxy chain (2-ethoxypropane name direct, locant via chain); all six branch boxes of ethyl_4_isopropyl_3_methyl_2_hexanal in traditional and systematic naming with independently checked targets and rewards; Greek condensed selection, wrong picks, representation and active-chain changes; acid, ketone, alcohol, ester and ether branches; FG, bond and alkoxy precedence, ambiguous-piece fallback, and molecule switching.
+- `probe-mode-quiz.js` — selection-mode 2D-style switches: an armed quiz must keep the viewer clean (0 green shapes), keep the target/prompt/comp5 selection and drop the picked atoms; picking the chain in the new style then shows the success line + green; a post-exact switch stays clean; with select mode off the classic component highlight still paints and survives a switch.
+- `probe-explain-all.js` — explain-all overview under selection mode: open/close cycles build exactly one table with per-component cells (no nested tables, no green paint), close restores the quiz prompt (or clears the panel), a style switch rebuilds cleanly with the quiz target kept, and an exact verdict keeps the table while painting green.
+- `probe-frag2.js` — compacted-label (e.g. COOH) whole-fragment pick (free selection):
+  CTM-derived center click, asserts whole-fragment on first click and
+  toggle-clear on re-click; hard-fail on miss or page error.
+- `probe-coverage56.js` — gap coverage: multiple H picks on one carbon in expanded mode (free picks stay atomic; armed-quiz H clicks redirect to the parent carbon with toggle symmetry and H-completed chains still exact), in-page
+  molecule-switch sticky re-arm (contents cleared, stays armed, quiz re-armed + prompt restored when comp5 sticks; condensed carbon-only anchor pick on the post-switch molecule),
+  `allowSelect` gating (hide entry when off, uncheck-while-active exits),
+  Present block (toggle no-op + CSS hides the entry). Hard-fail.
+- `probe-compact-main.js` — main-chain versus free compacted-label semantics: COOH/HCOOH/CN resolve to the anchor carbon under a main-chain target, NO2 stays a fragment, free selection stays a fragment; checks C-only paint, hover box, badge, exact reward, the free-mode backplate edge, clear/marker restore and methanal (no highlight geometry).
+- `probe-skel-joints.js` — skeletal vertex→atom assignment: for 16 molecules across aldehydes, ketones, acids, ester, alkene, alkyne, nitrile and nitro, asserts every vertex pick is an endpoint of all its incident bonds, no offset multi-line end is left unmerged, and every carbonyl carbon's incident-bond line endpoints (the old "click the carbon, get the oxygen" spot) select the carbon. Guards the C=O offset-end merge in `fMulerSelectVertices`.
+- `audit.js <port> <query|- > <width> <out>` — tooltip clip audit:
+  measures every `[data-tooltip]` bubble against overflow ancestors and the
+  viewport; prints TOTAL / SPILL count + offending entries.
+
+Conventions: selection state lives in `window.MulerUserSelection`;
+all pick/render functions fail closed (return null / no-op on any gap).
